metadata.question: Does forest cover decrease in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia (east region) from August 1986 to August 2001?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Landsat 5 TM Surface Reflectance (C02/T1_L2) for both 1986 and 2001; fallback to Landsat 7 ETM+ (C02/T1_L2) for 2001 if needed. - Date: August window (Aug 1–Sep 1). Fallback: Jul 15–Sep 15. - Location: Rectangle east of Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia (approx: [-63.25, -17.95, -62.85, -17.60]). 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA_PIXEL to mask clouds, shadows, snow; scale SR bands; compute NDVI; no cloud percentage property used—derive valid pixel fraction from mask. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: - If image collections are empty after fallbacks: C1. - If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either year: C2. - If any computed area/metric is null/NaN or invalid: C3. - Otherwise, compare forest area (NDVI ≥ 0.6) in km²; if 2001 < 1986 => A: Yes, else B: No. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line async function runAnalysis() { try { // Helper to evaluate server objects const ev = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject)); // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-63.25, -17.95, -62.85, -17.60], null, false); const scale = 1000; const maxPixels = 1e9; // Windows (semi-open end dates) function windowsForYear(year) { return [ {label: 'Aug', start: ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 8, 1), end: ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 9, 1)}, {label: 'Jul15-Sep15', start: ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 7, 15), end: ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 9, 15)} ]; } // Cloud/Shadow mask and scaling for Landsat 5/7 L2 function prepL57(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // snow const scaled = img.select(['SR_B3', 'SR_B4']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2) .rename(['red', 'nir']); return scaled.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); } async function tryDataset(dataset, year, win) { const colRaw = ee.ImageCollection(dataset) .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(win.start, win.end); const size = await ev(colRaw.size()); if (!size || size === 0) return {ok: false, reason: 'empty', dataset, win, size: 0}; const col = colRaw.map(prepL57).map(function(img) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['nir', 'red']).rename('NDVI'); return img.addBands(ndvi).clip(aoi); }); const composite = col.median().select(['red', 'nir', 'NDVI']).clip(aoi); // Valid pixel count on NDVI const validCount = await ev(composite.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }).get('NDVI')); if (!validCount || validCount === 0) { return {ok: false, reason: 'zerovalid', dataset, win, size}; } // Total grid cell count (reference) const totalCount = await ev(ee.Image.constant(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }).get('c')); const forestMask = composite.select('NDVI').gte(0.6); const forestAreaKm2 = await ev(ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6).updateMask(forestMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }).get('area')); const meanNdvi = await ev(composite.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }).get('NDVI')); return { ok: true, dataset, win, size, validCount, totalCount, forestAreaKm2, meanNdvi }; } async function processYear(year) { const wins = windowsForYear(year); // Order of datasets to try const datasets = ['LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2'].concat(year >= 1999 ? ['LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2'] : []); let bestEmpty = null; let bestZeroValid = null; for (const win of wins) { for (const ds of datasets) { const res = await tryDataset(ds, year, win); if (res.ok) return {...res, year}; if (res.reason === 'zerovalid' && !bestZeroValid) bestZeroValid = {...res, year}; if (res.reason === 'empty' && !bestEmpty) bestEmpty = {...res, year}; } } if (bestZeroValid) return bestZeroValid; // C2 after exhausting options return bestEmpty || {ok: false, reason: 'empty', year}; } const aoiAreaKm2 = await ev(ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }).get('area')); const y1 = await processYear(1986); const y2 = await processYear(2001); // Handle failure cases if (!aoiAreaKm2 || isNaN(aoiAreaKm2)) { console.log("AOI Area (km^2): null"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`AOI Area (km^2): ${aoiAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`); function labelRes(r) { if (!r || !r.win) return 'n/a'; return `${r.year} ${r.win.label} [${r.dataset && r.dataset.includes('LT05') ? 'L5' : 'L7'}]`; } if (!y1.ok && y1.reason === 'empty' || !y2.ok && y2.reason === 'empty') { console.log(`${labelRes(y1)} Images: ${y1.size || 0}`); console.log(`${labelRes(y2)} Images: ${y2.size || 0}`); console.log("C1"); return; } if ((!y1.ok && y1.reason === 'zerovalid') || (!y2.ok && y2.reason === 'zerovalid')) { const y1Valid = y1.validCount || 0; const y2Valid = y2.validCount || 0; console.log(`${labelRes(y1)} Images: ${y1.size || 0}, Valid px: ${y1Valid}`); console.log(`${labelRes(y2)} Images: ${y2.size || 0}, Valid px: ${y2Valid}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // Validate numbers const vals = [y1.forestAreaKm2, y2.forestAreaKm2, y1.validCount, y2.validCount, y1.totalCount, y2.totalCount, y1.meanNdvi, y2.meanNdvi]; if (vals.some(v => v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v))) { console.log("C3"); return; } const y1CloudPct = (1 - (y1.validCount / y1.totalCount)) * 100.0; const y2CloudPct = (1 - (y2.validCount / y2.totalCount)) * 100.0; console.log(`${labelRes(y1)} Images: ${y1.size}, Valid px: ${y1.validCount}, Mask%: ${y1CloudPct.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`${labelRes(y2)} Images: ${y2.size}, Valid px: ${y2.validCount}, Mask%: ${y2CloudPct.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`1986 Forest (km^2): ${y1.forestAreaKm2.toFixed(2)}, NDVIμ: ${y1.meanNdvi.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`2001 Forest (km^2): ${y2.forestAreaKm2.toFixed(2)}, NDVIμ: ${y2.meanNdvi.toFixed(3)}`); const diff = y2.forestAreaKm2 - y1.forestAreaKm2; const pct = (diff / (y1.forestAreaKm2 === 0 ? 1 : y1.forestAreaKm2)) * 100.0; console.log(`Change (km^2): ${diff.toFixed(2)} (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)`); // Final Answer if (!isFinite(diff) || !isFinite(pct)) { console.log("C3"); return; } if (diff < 0) { console.log("A: Yes"); } else { console.log("B: No"); } } catch (err) { // In case of method errors, dataset/band issues, memory, etc. console.error(String(err)); console.log("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
